literal: Wealth / those who are not / as worthy / makes / wealth / other than / there is no / wealth.
translation: There is nothing of real value other than wealth, which turns even worthless people into people of worth.
modern: ஒரு பொருட்டாக மதிக்கத்தகாதவர்களையும் மதிக்கத்தக்கவர்களாகச் செய்யும் செல்வத்தைத் தவிர, உலகில் சிறந்த பொருள் வேறு எதுவும் இல்லை.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the transformative power of wealth in society. The word 'poruḷ' is used repeatedly here to mean both material wealth and intrinsic worth or significance. It states that wealth can elevate even those who lack personal merit into people of importance. Therefore, apart from such wealth, there is no other substance of true practical value in the world.
